title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Partial Claim Amount Calculation
content:
A VA partial claim on a VA Home Loan Guaranty loan in default is paid at the largest amount the partial claim room allows. The partial claim paid is the partial claim ceiling percentage of the unpaid principal balance the record shows at the first unpaid installment, less the partial claims already paid on the loan, never less than zero, rounded to the cent.

## Definitions

- **Unpaid principal balance.** The unpaid principal balance the loan record shows at the first unpaid installment.
- **Ceiling percentage.** The program's partial claim ceiling, a program figure of the VA Home Loan Guaranty.
- **Service-connected uplift.** Percentage points added to the ceiling percentage; in this calculation, 0.
- **Ceiling amount.** The ceiling percentage plus the service-connected uplift, applied to the unpaid principal balance the record shows at the first unpaid installment, divided by one hundred and rounded to the cent.
- **Partial claim debt carried against the ceiling.** The partial claims already paid on the loan: the sum of the partial claim entries in the loan's money transactions.
- **Reduction for other debts.** In this calculation, nil.
- **Partial claim paid.** The ceiling amount less the partial claim debt carried against the ceiling and less the reduction for other debts, never less than zero, rounded to the cent.

The ceiling amount is rounded first; the subtractions are made from the rounded ceiling amount, the result is floored at zero and then rounded to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical loans, ceiling percentage taken as 30)

| Line | Loan 1 | Loan 2 | Loan 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unpaid principal balance at the first unpaid installment | 180,000.00 | 180,000.00 | 40,000.00 |
| Ceiling amount: balance multiplied by 30 and divided by one hundred | 54,000.00 | 54,000.00 | 12,000.00 |
| Partial claims already paid on the loan | 0.00 | 10,000.00 | 15,000.00 |
| Partial claim paid | 54,000.00 | 44,000.00 | 0.00 (never less than zero) |
